column1: The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is
Whether Mr. S. Ranasinghe, Civil Engineer - Grade II of the Sri Lanka Transport Board who's service had been suspended on
two instances from 25.10.2010 to February 2011 and from 23.08.2011 to 25.04.2012 on half pay had been caused injustice by not
receiving the half pay unpaid during the period of suspension, promotions and other reliefs even after being reinstated in
service and if so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
